channel.title: Strictly Come Dancing
channel.desc: Tess and Claud welcome you to our annual Blackpool extravaganza, live from the iconic Tower Ballroom. The show begins with a spectacular routine from our professionals featuring the one and only Steps. Our couples then take to the world-famous sprung floor for their biggest performances to date. When the vote opens at the end of the show, who will you think has delivered a show-stopping performance?
